Dataset brief description: Multilingual lexical resource extracted from Wiktionary and published as Linguistic Linked Open Data in RDF with the W3C OntoLex-Lemon vocabulary. Covers 27 Wiktionary language editions, is re-extracted twice a month, and offers Turtle dumps plus a public SPARQL endpoint. The content is written and curated by volunteer Wiktionary contributors, not by any public administration. License CC BY-SA 3.0.
